groups.name: pages
groups.about: Make, read and write pages: content, title, icon and cover, Markdown in, duplicating and moving pages and blocks — e.g. notion-create-pages, notion-update-page, notion-move-pages

groups.name: databases
groups.about: Make a database and change its structure: properties (columns), who sees one, the row page layout, ready-made databases — e.g. notion-create-database, notion-update-data-source, leafen_catalog

groups.name: rows-tasks
groups.about: Database rows and tasks: query rows, add one, change its values, row templates, pass a row on, your tasks and deadlines — e.g. notion-query-data-sources, POST /pages/{pageId}/database-row-values

groups.name: views-forms-automations
groups.about: Database views, forms and automations: make or change a view, a form's questions, automations, database buttons, sprints — e.g. notion-create-view, POST /forms

groups.name: comments
groups.about: Comments and suggested edits on pages and rows: add, edit, delete, react, resolve a discussion, accept or reject a suggestion — e.g. notion-create-comment, notion-resolve-suggested-edit

groups.name: find-links
groups.about: Find pages and what links them: search, recent, favorite, shared and private pages, backlinks, mentions, link previews — e.g. leafen_search, notion-list-page-backlinks, PUT /pages/{pageId}/favorite

groups.name: page-details
groups.about: A page's finer parts: locking it for everyone, font and full width, synced blocks, buttons and templates, wiki and verified pages, reactions, places — e.g. PATCH /pages/{id}/metadata

groups.name: sharing
groups.about: Share a page: who has access at what level, publish to the web, guest and view-only links, apps on a page, access requests — e.g. POST /pages/{pageId}/public-mutations

groups.name: trash
groups.about: Trash and bring back: trash pages, rows, databases and properties, list the trash, restore, delete for good, empty it — e.g. notion-delete-pages, notion-restore-pages, POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/trash/empty

groups.name: history
groups.about: Page history and activity: past versions, restore or revert one, named versions, who viewed or edited, analytics — e.g. notion-view-version, notion-restore-version, GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/activities

groups.name: files
groups.about: Files and pictures: upload, download, attach or replace a file, a block's file, document files, file cleanup and usage — e.g. notion-create-file-upload, leafen_get_file

groups.name: notifications
groups.about: Inbox and notifications: read the inbox, mark read, archive, remind later, notification settings, email, browser push and Slack — e.g. leafen_inbox, leafen_inbox_read, PATCH /account/notifications

groups.name: workspaces
groups.about: Workspaces: list, make, rename or delete one, transfer ownership, custom emoji, the sidebar's layout and tabs — e.g. leafen_list_workspaces, POST /workspaces, POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/owner-transfer

groups.name: members
groups.about: Members and invites: invite by email or link with a role, change a role, remove members and guests, email domains, join requests — e.g. POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/members

groups.name: people-teams
groups.about: People and teams: the people directory and profiles, teamspaces and their invite links, permission groups — e.g. notion-get-users, notion-get-teams, POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/teamspace-mutations

groups.name: my-account
groups.about: Your own account: name, photo, language, display, email addresses, workspace order, switching accounts, deleting it — e.g. PATCH /account/profile, PUT /account/language

groups.name: my-security
groups.about: Your login security: password, 2-step verification, passkeys, sessions, login history, app passwords — e.g. PUT /account/password, POST /account/mfa/totp/enroll, GET /account/sessions

groups.name: sign-in
groups.about: Logging in and signing up before a session: log in, register, accept an invitation, reset a password, check an email, a browser's login — e.g. POST /auth/login, POST /auth/register, leafen_sign_in_requests

groups.name: this-connection
groups.about: This agent's own connection and Leafen itself: what it reaches, its workspaces and switches, steps only the person does, long jobs, bug reports — e.g. notion-get-self, notion-get-tool-access, leafen_bug_report

groups.name: agent-connections
groups.about: List, make or remove one, its page, apps and services, connection codes, consent, OAuth apps — e.g. leafen_connection_requests, GET /mcp/connections

groups.name: integrations
groups.about: Integrations, API tokens and webhooks: internal integrations with tokens, owners and webhooks, personal access tokens, workspace webhooks — e.g. POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/internal-connections

groups.name: external-services
groups.about: External services (other MCP servers, such as mail or an issue tracker): add one, log it in, its tools, call them — e.g. leafen_services, leafen_service_call, POST /mcp-services

groups.name: imports
groups.about: Imports: bring files, archives, Markdown, HTML or CSV into a workspace or database, folders kept in step, follow an import — e.g. POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/imports

groups.name: notion-migration
groups.about: Migrate a Notion workspace into Leafen step by step: connect, scan, plan, run, verify and finish — e.g. leafen_notion_migration_guide, leafen_notion_migration_start, leafen_notion_migration_status

groups.name: notion-import
groups.about: Notion imports without the guided migration: Notion connections, import jobs, their file and block problems, retrying, Notion-style OAuth — e.g. POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/notion-import/jobs

groups.name: exports-moves
groups.about: Export a workspace or move it: workspace and whole-server exports, downloads, moving a workspace or page to another server — e.g. POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/exports, leafen_workspace_move

groups.name: backups-server-move
groups.about: Backups and moving the server: back up now or on a schedule, where backups go, their password, replication, moving the server (GET /admin/backups/schedule reads them) — e.g. POST /admin/backups, leafen_server_move

groups.name: restore-standby
groups.about: Restoring and standing by: restore from a backup or replica and undo it, a standby server that takes over, restoring at setup (GET /admin/backups/schedule reads the standby) — e.g. leafen_restore_run, leafen_standby

groups.name: server-settings
groups.about: The server itself: its address and remote access, network proxy, mail (SMTP), settings, version, reports, setup steps — e.g. leafen_remote_access, PATCH /admin/settings, leafen_server_version

groups.name: server-admin
groups.about: The administrator over all accounts and workspaces: make an account, reset a password, make an administrator, every workspace's pages and files, audit log — e.g. POST /admin/accounts, GET /admin/audit

groups.name: organization-access
groups.about: An organization's login rules: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, login providers, login and guest 2-step policies, agent clients — e.g. PUT /organizations/{organizationId}/saml

groups.name: organization-accounts
groups.about: An organization's managed accounts: list, rename, change email, suspend, log out, reset passwords, delete or restore, key policy — e.g. GET /organizations/{organizationId}/managed-users

groups.name: organization-compliance
groups.about: An organization's audit and compliance: audit log and exports, retention, eDiscovery, legal holds, DLP, sharing and storage policies (GET /organizations reads its storage limit) — e.g. GET /organizations/{organizationId}/audit-events

groups.name: apps
groups.about: Using Leafen apps and their tools: apps you can use, asking for or installing one, its credentials and schedules, calling a tool — e.g. leafen_app_tools, leafen_app_call, GET /installed-apps

groups.name: app-admin
groups.about: Apps on the server, for its administrator: install, remove or restore an app, status, grants, credentials, secrets, settings, schedules — e.g. POST /admin/apps/installs

groups.name: app-oversight
groups.about: Which apps the server offers and watching them: catalogs, the allowlist, app requests, strict mode, an app's usage, log, jobs and guests (GET /admin/apps reads what is set) — e.g. POST /admin/apps/catalogs

groups.name: app-runtime
groups.about: What a running app calls for itself: its storage, data, rooms, guests and guest links, OAuth accounts, actions, relays and hooks — e.g. POST /apps/{installId}/storage, POST /apps/{installId}/actions/{action}

groups.name: screen-plumbing
groups.about: What Leafen's screens and other Leafen servers call under the hood, rarely needed: live sync, change streams, login walls, beacons, server-move file transfer — e.g. GET /bootstrap, GET /collaboration/{room}
